shape: python scripts/run-tests.py, which is pytest -q -n auto -m "not acceptance": the shape scripts/nightly-refresh.py actually runs. The count read is pytest's own "N skipped" from that run's summary line.
note: Shrink-only, same contract as config/tmp-leak-baseline.json. The ceiling on how many tests the nightly may see SKIPPED and still move the day-mode green marker. It is not a coverage target: it is the line between a suite that passed and a suite that did not run. MEASURED 2026-09-05 in HELM on the tree at a0931fe: an ordinary developer shell skipped 2; the same suite under `env -i` with a full PATH skipped 5, the extra three being the systemd-bus tests that skip when DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS is absent. 5 is the higher of the two observed honest values, so a launcher without a session bus does not go red on a night that ran everything it could. On the same tree, a run whose PATH was replaced by the systemd user manager's (no ~/.local/bin, no ~/bin, no nvm node bin) skipped 240 and exited 0, and that is the run this number exists to refuse. Raising it is a deliberate act and the wrong first move: a jump means tests stopped running, so find what the launcher can no longer reach (gh, git-lfs, node, npx, marp, uv, pre-commit, claude and herdr are the tools the suite gates on) before touching this file. This number describes HELM, which is the only clone the nightly runs in. MEASURED 2026-09-05 in the yard-hollow-green worktree, the same suite skipped 52, so a nightly driven by hand from a worktree refuses, which is the correct answer rather than a bug to tune around. The REASON is recorded because an earlier draft of this sentence got it wrong, saying a YARD carries no private data overlay. It does. Verified by resolving the seam from inside a YARD checkout: get_data_root() returns the real shared overlay and crm/, auto-memory/, outputs/ and threads/ are all present, which is by design, since the bootstrap copies .env from HELM, strips WORKSPACE_ROOT and writes an absolute HEADING_OS_DATA. The 52 break down, by grouped skip reason, as 21 HELM-only entry points correctly refusing to run from a worktree, 6 for the absent .codegraph index, about 7 whose fixtures look for the overlay BESIDE the checkout (true at the main clone, false at .yard/.heading-os/<branch>), 2 needing a local embedder, and the rest one-offs. Every YARD is REQUIRED to know the data repository and to write every artifact it produces there rather than into the engine (operator, 2026-09-05). Consumed by read_skip_ceiling() in scripts/nightly-refresh.py; a missing, unparseable or non-integer value makes the night refuse rather than default.
